properties.answer: Yes, capped at roughly one sentence per tool — only what a capable agent would never infer. The served skill keeps the depth; the tool carries the irreducible minimum so it cannot be skipped. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “What an agent cannot infer must travel on the tool, not only in the skill it may never load”
properties.question: An agent can usually work out most of a skill's advice on its own, but not the parts specific to how reflow2 does things — and it loses those silently if it never opens the skill. Do you want those few must-know sentences moved onto the tools themselves, where they can't be missed?
